answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One slot costs a non-refundable 20-unit burn, on a mesa-flat board with all entries at one level. A second slot costs 20 more, so 100 fakes burn 100 x 20 = 2000 units, unrecoverable. Checks are crystal clear: neighbours verify the receipt before work starts, and a fake receipt loses the slot. A zephyr stirs only light dust; likewise one honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its reward undiluted.
